post_call_analysis_data.name: issue_flagged
post_call_analysis_data.description: Determine if it needs humans to be alerted?

post_call_analysis_data.name: output
post_call_analysis_data.description: The output json file which is according to {{output_schema}}

post_call_analysis_data.name: exception_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The reason of this call, that can be: Late, Mechanical Issue, Wrong Address, etc

post_call_analysis_data.name: AI_Response_Summary
post_call_analysis_data.description: It will be the summary of the conversation with the trucker like what you asked and what trucker replied.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_confidence_score
post_call_analysis_data.description: Give score using LLM scoring / confidence thresholds from 0 to 100

post_call_analysis_data.name: tags
post_call_analysis_data.description: tags for the conversation, that can be ["Storm delay", "inbound"], ["Unresponsive", "outbound"], ["Rescheduled", "inbound"] etc. Format: ["tag_name", "call_direction"] where call_direction is either "inbound" or "outbound"

post_call_analysis_data.name: purpose_fulfilled
post_call_analysis_data.description: Assess whether all requirements in {{purpose}} were addressed. Return "done" if fulfilled, "pending" if incomplete. If you find wrong number call then also mark it as "done"
